title: IVG Intense Salts Tropical Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Tropical Ice blends sharp Kiwi, juicy Watermelon and crisp Green Apple, layered over a cooling Ice base. The combination delivers a balance of tangy and sweet notes, lifted by a refreshing chill. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt ensures consistent flavour delivery, discreet vapour production and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s well suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Tropical Ice offers a mix of exotic fruits with a cooling twist for fruit-and-menthol fans.
